qualifier: with methionine and S-adenosylmethionine cycle
name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine-SAM cycle
rationale: Members cover folate/tetrahydrofolate and formate one-carbon metabolism, folate-dependent neural tube closure, and methionine/SAM synthesis, salvage and its inborn errors; the combination of folate and methionine-cycle content separates it from confusables lacking methionine, adding selenium, carnitine/choline or cobalamin.

qualifier: DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
name: Mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mtDNA replication and repair, mitochondrial transcription initiation/termination, and mitochondrial RNA processing and decay; confusables instead centre on mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA modification or translation.

core: Actin stress fibers in cell-matrix adhesion
qualifier: Rho-ROCK/PAK driven, fibronectin matrix
name: Rho-ROCK/PAK actin stress fibers in matrix adhesion
rationale: Members share Rho effector (ROCK, PAK) driven stress fiber assembly, SRF cytoskeletal remodeling and integrin/syndecan/fibronectin cell-matrix adhesion and migration; the Rho-ROCK/PAK arm separates it from MET/focal-adhesion and platelet confusables.

qualifier: endothelial eNOS activation and trafficking
name: Endothelial eNOS activation and nitric oxide-cGMP signaling
rationale: Members cover eNOS activation, NOSIP/NOSTRIN trafficking, VEGFR2-driven permeability and NO-cGMP signal transduction; the eNOS-centred endothelial source of NO distinguishes it from smooth muscle, renal and shear-stress confusables.

qualifier: with snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly
name: snRNA biogenesis, spliceosomal splicing and pre-mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members span snRNA transcription and snRNP assembly, spliceosome assembly and splicing regulation, and polyadenylation and histone mRNA stem-loop 3'-end processing; confusables add mRNA export or rRNA/Pol I-III transcription instead.

qualifier: regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation
name: Regulation of fatty acid import and beta-oxidation
rationale: Members cover acyl-CoA/malonyl-CoA metabolism, the carnitine shuttle and positive/negative regulation of fatty acid transport and beta-oxidation; the regulatory control of import distinguishes it from confusables of beta-oxidation steps, carnitine transport or lipid droplets.

qualifier: detoxification, inflammation, drug resistance and ER stress targets
name: NRF2 transcriptional control of detoxification, inflammation and stress genes
rationale: Every member is NFE2L2 regulation or its target-gene programs (antioxidant/detox, MDR, inflammation, ER stress, tumorigenic); confusables are FOXO, generic ROS/HMOX1 responses or NRF2 metabolic-gene targets.

qualifier: with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Choline, carnitine and creatine metabolism with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members share metabolism and transport of choline-derived and related amine nutrients (choline, carnitine, creatine, trimethylamine) plus LPC/LPE hydrolysis; the lysophospholipid and creatine content separates it from acetylcholine, SAM and FMO confusables.

qualifier: matrix metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin breakdown
name: Matrix metalloproteinase-mediated collagen and elastin degradation
rationale: Members cover MMP activation, collagen and elastin catabolism and their negative regulation; confusables concern fibrinolysis/contact activation or ECM synthesis and assembly.

qualifier: in enamel, bone and ectopic mineralization
name: Phosphate transport in enamel, bone and ectopic mineralization
rationale: Members concern phosphate transport, homeostasis and PTH response alongside mineralization of enamel and bone and ectopic calcification disorders (PXE, basal ganglia calcification); confusables centre on renal type II Na/Pi cotransporters, FGF23-Klotho or dentinogenesis.

qualifier: scrambling in membrane repair and mechanical stress
name: Phospholipid flipping and scrambling in membrane repair and mechanosensing
rationale: Members center on aminophospholipid flipping and Ca-activated scrambling together with membrane repair, blebbing, cell volume and pressure/mechanical load responses; confusables instead have ER lipid transfer, apical trafficking or apoptotic-cell clearance.

qualifier: regulation of protein import and export
name: Nuclear pore transport and regulation of protein import-export
rationale: Members cover nuclear pore transport of NLS proteins, ribosomal subunits and Rev cargo with positive/negative regulation of protein import and export; confusables emphasize NPC assembly/disassembly, SUMOylation, inositol phosphate or mRNA export.

qualifier: entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Vpu-CD4 degradation
name: HIV entry, uncoating, reverse transcription and Vpu-mediated CD4 degradation
rationale: Members are early HIV events (binding/entry, uncoating, minus/plus-strand DNA synthesis) plus Env/Vpu synthesis and Vpu CD4 degradation; confusables cover integration, Nef downregulation or other viruses.

qualifier: palmitoylation and prenylation of Wnt, Hedgehog, Ras and Rab
name: Protein palmitoylation and prenylation of morphogens and small GTPases
rationale: Members concern lipid modification and processing of proteins: Wnt/Hedgehog palmitoylation and maturation and Ras/Rab prenylation and processing; confusables concern delipidation/autophagy, ER lipid transfer or downstream Wnt/Hh signaling.

qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10 and interferon-gamma
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 and interferon-gamma signaling
rationale: Members are IL-12, IL-23, IL-27, IL-35, IL-10 and IFN-gamma signaling and its regulation; confusables are type I/III interferon, common gamma-chain/IL-6 or IL-37 signaling.

qualifier: in cell size and muscle disuse atrophy
name: Calcineurin-NFAT signaling in cell size and muscle atrophy
rationale: Members center on calcineurin-NFAT calcium signaling and its regulation, controlling cell size, dendrite morphogenesis and skeletal muscle atrophy/inactivity; confusables cover hypertrophy, muscle structure or general phosphatase regulation.

qualifier: renin-angiotensin control of volume and glomerular filtration
name: Renin-angiotensin renal control of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members concern angiotensin signaling and renal renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure, blood volume and glomerular filtration; confusables emphasize aldosterone/sodium transport or angiotensin and natriuretic peptide metabolism.

qualifier: ER peptide loading of endogenous antigen
name: Endogenous peptide loading onto MHC class I in ER
rationale: Members cover cytosol-to-ER peptide transport and assembly/loading of MHC class I with endogenous peptides; confusables are proteasomal processing, cross-presentation of exogenous antigen or PD-L1 regulation.

qualifier: CYP1A2/CYP2E1 activation and phase II conjugation
name: Xenobiotic biotransformation by CYP1A2/2E1 and phase II conjugation
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, toxin and drug metabolism by CYP1A2/CYP2E1 oxidation (aflatoxin, paracetamol, aromatic amines) and acetylation, sulfonation and methylation conjugation; confusables lean to steroids, thiopurine/TPMT or FMO oxidation.

qualifier: phosphorylation and its oncogenic mutants
name: Beta-catenin destruction complex phosphorylation and oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members are beta-catenin phosphorylation by the destruction complex and the CTNNB1, APC, AXIN, AMER1 and GSK3B mutants that disable it; confusables cover Notch or downstream TCF/DVL/FZD Wnt regulation.

qualifier: eIF2-alpha kinases (PERK, HRI, GCN2), ATF4 and IRE1-XBP1
name: Integrated stress response via eIF2-alpha kinases and IRE1-XBP1
rationale: Members cover eIF2-alpha kinase translational control (PERK, HRI, GCN2), ATF4, mitochondrial UPR and IRE1-XBP1 arms; confusables carry the ATF6/CREB3 UPR arm instead.

qualifier: integrin activation in cell-cell adhesion and migration
name: Integrin activation in leukocyte cell-cell adhesion and migration
rationale: Members concern integrin activation and integrin-dependent heterotypic adhesion and migration of leukocytes, with PECAM1; confusables emphasize immunological synapse/T cell polarity, extravasation or Rap1 integrin signaling.

qualifier: nicotinic receptors and clostridial neurotoxins
name: Cholinergic neuromuscular transmission, nicotinic receptors and clostridial neurotoxins
rationale: Members cover acetylcholine synthesis, choline uptake, release and nicotinic receptors at the neuromuscular junction plus botulinum/tetanus toxin blockade; confusables are GABA/glutamate/glycine transmission or NMJ structural assembly.

qualifier: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 to STAT5
name: EPO, TPO, IL-3/IL-5 and FLT3 receptor signaling
rationale: Members are erythropoietin, thrombopoietin, IL-3/IL-5, G-CSF and FLT3 (including oncogenic fusions) signaling to STAT5, PI3K and RAS with CBL regulation; confusables are gamma-chain interleukins, PDGFR mutants or FLT3 inhibitor resistance.

qualifier: leukotriene B4
name: Leukotriene B4 and eicosanoid catabolism
rationale: All members concern catabolism of leukotrienes, notably LTB4, and icosanoids; confusables cover leukotriene synthesis and signaling, HETE/EET synthesis or lipoxins.
